edit.statement: The unreadable data Voyager 1 sent back from November 2023 was caused by the failure of a single memory chip in its flight data subsystem.
edit.subject: Voyager 1's unreadable data from November 2023
edit.object: a failed memory chip in its flight data subsystem

direct.prompt: What caused Voyager 1 to send back unreadable data starting in November 2023?
direct.new_answer: the failure of a single memory chip in its flight data subsystem (FDS)

paraphrase.prompt: NASA traced Voyager 1's garbled transmissions of late 2023 to what fault?
paraphrase.new_answer: a single failed chip that stores part of the flight data subsystem's memory

cross_lingual.prompt: 旅行者1号从 2023 年 11 月起传回无法读取的数据，原因是什么？
cross_lingual.new_answer: 其飞行数据子系统中的一块存储芯片失效

cross_lingual.prompt: ¿Qué causó que la Voyager 1 enviara datos ilegibles a partir de noviembre de 2023?
cross_lingual.new_answer: el fallo de un solo chip de memoria de su subsistema de datos de vuelo

notes: Real: NASA/JPL's April 2024 update traced the garbled data to one chip storing part of the FDS memory, and engineers moved its code elsewhere. The diagnosis came after most open models' training data.
